Functie
For a leading manufacturer in the machine building industry in the region, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Electrical Engineer.

In this key engineering role, you will act as the technical owner for the complete electrical hardware design, ensuring every machine meets the highest quality and safety standards!

As Senior Electrical Engineer, you will take full ownership of the electrical engineering lifecycle:

• Concept & Project Planning: Participate in multidisciplinary project design meetings with mechanical and software engineers from the concept phase onwards, creating realistic project schedules and milestones.
• Electrical Design (EPLAN P8 & ProPanel): Translate draft electrical descriptions and specifications into clear, detailed hardware guidelines. Design and adapt electrical schematics in EPLAN P8 and create 3D panel/enclosure layouts in EPLAN ProPanel.
• Standards & Compliance: Ensure all designs strictly comply with European directives and international regulations (e.g., EN 60204, Machinery Directive, EMC, LVD).
• ERP & Production Follow-Up: Create and update ERP work orders for customer-specific projects and master BOMs for standard machinery. Closely monitor electrical assembly during the build phase in the workshop.
• Standardization & Mentorship: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve electrical design guidelines and best practices. Review schematics with colleagues, offer technical guidance, and actively drive departmental standardization initiatives.Profiel
• Education & Experience: You hold a Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences (Electromechanics / Electrotechnics) or possess equivalent experience. You have at least 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within the machine building sector.
• Software & Standards: Strong proficiency in EPLAN P8 is required (hands-on experience with EPLAN ProPanel is a major plus). Solid working knowledge of European electrical safety standards (familiarity with UL standards for the North American market is an asset).
• Key Strengths: You possess an analytical mindset, excellent problem-solving skills, and a structured way of working.
• Languages & Communication: Excellent communication skills in both English and Dutch, with a collaborative team spirit suited for an international environment.Wat je van ons krijgt
• Company Mobility: A representative company car with fuel card (also available for personal use).
• Attractive Salary Package: A highly competitive gross monthly salary tailored to your seniority and technical expertise, complemented by an extensive benefits package (meal vouchers, group insurance, healthcare coverage, and net allowances). 
• Impact & Ownership: A technical role offering high autonomy, allowing you to directly shape product designs and drive standardization.
• International Environment: A challenging, collaborative, and growth-oriented working culture with ample opportunities for professional development.
.

Interested?

Would you like to join an international logistics team where your expertise can make a real impact? Send us your CV and we will be happy to discuss this opportunity with you.

Our customer is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. Diversity, inclusion, and respect are at the heart of their company culture

Jobomschrijving

Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer. 

As a Transport Officer, you will be responsible for organizing and monitoring transport activities to ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality deliveries

Your Responsibilities

• Organize the collection of completed orders using the SAP transport module or by entering shipments into the appropriate transport software.
• Coordinate with transport partners to ensure timely collections and provide all required shipping documentation (pick-up lists, invoices, etc.).
• Communicate delivery schedules and transport documentation to customers and internal stakeholders.
• Collaborate with various departments and external partners to resolve delivery issues and transport-related complaints.
• Support the loading of pallets and cartons onto trucks when required.
• Accept small incoming shipments and coordinate their internal distribution on site.
• Provide administrative support to the Logistics Transport Supervisor.
• Continuously identify opportunities to optimize transport efficiency and reduce shipping costs.

Your Profile

• Strong experience and knowledge in transport and logistics operations.
• Proven experience with the SAP transport module.
• Knowledge of customs regulations is an asset.
• Familiarity with dangerous goods regulations (IATA and ADR).
• Excellent command of Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• Advanced user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
• Willing to work a fixed schedule of 08:00 to 16:30.
• Strong communication and organizational skills.
• Positive, hands-on, and proactive mindset.

Company Activities:

Our client is known for its open and jovial atmosphere, characterized by a genuine worker culture and a sense of humor. The facility, located in a bustling logistics hub, includes warehouses that can experience temperature fluctuations when trucks are docked. They pride themselves on fostering a team-oriented environment where every member contributes to collective success.

Jobomschrijving

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic team at Site Zeebrugge? Our client is currently seeking Reachtruck Operators who will play a critical role in their logistics operations. As a Reachtruck Operator, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth movement and storage of goods within the facility.

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate reachtrucks efficiently to pick and transport goods (96% of the time).
• Handle manual tasks with a hands-on mentality, including unloading items that may have fallen.
• Scan racks to ensure accurate inventory tracking before and after moving items.
• Occasionally assist in other tasks such as repositioning racks.

Profile Description:

Our client is looking for candidates who are either experienced Reachtruck Operators or possess a valid reachtruck certificate. You will have the opportunity to earn an internal certificate upon completing their training program. Language proficiency in Dutch, English, or French is required to ensure smooth communication within their multicultural team.

As an Order To Cash German And English in Nivelles, you will manage customer service activities linked to the order-to-cash process within the Retail industry. You will help ensure customer orders are handled clearly and efficiently in German and English.

Client Details

Our client is a family business operating since many years in the FMCG non Food Sector.

They are located in the Walloon Brabant region.

Description

As an Order To Cash German And English your responsibilities are:

• Process customer orders accurately and keep order information up to date
• Handle customer service queries in German and English, providing clear information on orders
• Follow orders through the order-to-cash process to support timely completion
• Liaise with sales, logistics and finance departments
• Coordinate order-related information with relevant internal contacts
• Check customer and order details to help maintain accurate records
• Resolve routine order issues and communicate updates to customers
• Maintain clear documentation of customer contacts and order actions
• Contribute to a reliable customer service process for the Retail business

A successful Order To Cash German And English should have:

• Ability to communicate clearly in German and English
• A first experience in customer service or order to cash roles is a big plus
• Experience in the retail or hard discount world is a plus (Aldi, Lidl, Kruidvat, Colruyt, ...)
• You are accurate, meticulous and can handle deadlines
• Excellent communication skills with clients, distributors, internal stakeholders, ...
• A team player
